title: 第五卷三十七霸天下第五卷三十六归处
content_zh:
第五卷（三十七）霸·天下
霸王星不在联邦星域的常规航道上。
这个名字在星图上被标注为“霸”，后面跟着一行小字：未经注册的独立星域，主权归属不明，进入需自行承担风险。江流云翻遍联邦情报部的档案，只找到三行字——“重力约为紫月星三倍，原住民以战斗天赋著称，文明形态介于部落联盟与星际城邦之间。有记载的试炼场两处：胜者为王竞技场，心魔道场。警告：试炼场规则由当地古老契约维持，外来者一旦签署，必须遵守，不得反悔。”
他把档案递给惜若，问了一句：“你确定要带他们去？”
惜若接过档案扫了一眼，剑眉微挑：“三倍重力。正好，紫月星太轻了，这帮人骨头都快酥了。”她把档案合上，带着三分挑衅七分笃定，“清澜在忘川被混沌镜灵侵蚀过，灵力根基虽然保住了，但有些暗伤需要在高压环境下才能逼出来。霸王星的试炼场我早有耳闻——那里的战斗规则不是谁灵力强谁赢，是谁更能在极端压力下保持自我。这对她来说不是比赛，是康复。”
江流云沉默了一会儿，然后点了点头：“人手怎么带？”
“清澜，黯，霓家五姐妹，双双和东东也去——异兽的感知在那种地方比人管用。”
江流云看着惜若及两只异兽没有再说话。
众人第二天出发。霸王星没有直达航线，双双瞬移了两次才抵达外围。刚穿过空间裂隙，船上的重力警报就响了起来，所有人体内的灵力运转都像被灌了铅，举手投足比平时多花三倍的力气。东东不舒服地甩着脑袋，双双的两只头同时低吼了一声，双双的瞬移能力在这里被压制了至少一半——霸王星的空间法则和别处不一样，这里的空气都带着铁锈和旧血混合的气味，地面是暗红色的硬土，踩上去会发出细碎的沙沙声。远处山脉的轮廓像一排巨兽的獠牙咬在天际线上。
霸王星首府是一座用黑色巨石砌成的城池，没有城墙，因为不需要——城池本身就是一座山，整座山被掏空，街道和建筑沿着山体内的甬道层层叠叠地延伸。最高处是一座宫殿，霸王星星主的居所。
星主敖霸是个身高近两米的壮汉，皮肤呈古铜色，须发浓密，声如洪钟。他在宫殿正厅接待了紫月联邦一行人，态度豪爽中带着不加掩饰的傲慢。
不过他确实有傲慢的资本，作为星域最强重力的星球，任何人的实力都会受到非常巨大的压制，而且他的主上还是个创世级别的人物。
“紫月联邦？听说过。最近在星域里名声很大嘛，连深空议会都让你们给拆了。”敖霸坐在铺满兽皮的宝座上，居高临下地打量着惜若，“不过我们霸王星不认联邦，也不认议会。我们只认拳头。你们想参加胜者为王试炼，可以。按规矩来——签契约，打擂台，赢的拿奖励，输的认命。没问题吧？”
他旁边站着一个年轻人，身形和他父亲一样魁梧，长相也算英俊，但嘴角始终挂着一丝不太对劲的笑。敖霸指了指他：“这是犬子敖征，这次试炼由他主持。年轻人之间多交流交流，我就不掺和了。”
敖征抱拳行了个礼，手势很标准，但目光扫过清澜和霓家五姐妹时多停了那一瞬，让人很不舒服。不是那种轻浮的好色，是猎人在评估猎物的价值。清澜面无表情地回视了他一眼，手按在腰间短刀刀柄上——不是威胁，是习惯。
胜者为王的擂台设在城池正中央的角斗场。一座巨大的圆形石台，地面用不知名的黑色石材铺就，上面布满深浅不一的凹痕和裂纹，每一道凹痕都是一场战斗留下的印记。石台边缘没有护栏，掉下去就算输。观众席沿着山体向上延伸，此刻座无虚席——霸王星人对战斗的热情已经渗透到了血液里，一场外来者的挑战足以让全城万人空巷。
赛制简单粗暴：车轮战。挑战者连续对战十名守擂者，全部击败即为冠军。守擂者由霸王星最强的战士组成，每个人的战斗风格都不同。车轮战不允许休息，不允许补充灵力，不允许更换装备。敖征站在观众席最高处的主持台上，声音被灵力放大到整个角斗场都能听见：“紫月联邦挑战者——杨清澜。第一擂，开始！”
第一名守擂者是一尊铁塔般的壮汉。他在三倍重力下移动仍然迅猛如猎豹，双拳套着布满尖刺的灵力护甲，每一拳砸下来都带着千斤之力。清澜没有拔刀。韩昌教她的第一个原则：面对力量型对手，不要硬接第一招，先看他的发力习惯。她在擂台边缘连续闪避了七个回合，脚步在三倍重力下依然轻盈如燕，直到她看清了壮汉右拳挥出后左肋有一个极其短暂的间隙。第八个回合，她侧身切入间隙，短刀刀背精准地敲在他腋下神经丛上。壮汉整条右臂瞬间麻痹，铁塔般的身躯轰然倒地，石台都震了一下。
观众席安静了一瞬，然后爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼声。霸王星人欣赏强者，不论出身。
第二名是蛇形刺客。第三名是双刀客。第四名是远程灵力弓手。清澜一个一个地打下擂台，每一个对手她都是先观察、再闪避、最后用最少的力量一击破敌。韩昌的剑法精髓不是快，不是狠，是“准”，是把每一分力气都用在刀刃上，不浪费一丝一毫。

打到第七个时，清澜额头上终于见了汗，呼吸也微微急促起来。观众席上，霓波忽然低声说：“有人在干扰她的灵力运转。不是擂台上的对手，是从上面下来的。”她手指极隐蔽地指向主持台方向。霓涟顺着她指的方向看过去，敖征站在主持台上，双手背在身后，看起来毫无异常，但他右手食指上一枚暗红色的戒指正在发出极微弱的幽光。霓影闭眼感知了一瞬，再睁眼时声音冷得像冰：“那枚戒指在释放一种极低频的灵力干扰波。不影响擂台上的守擂者，只针对清澜。干扰频率和她体内灵力运转的节奏刚好错开半拍——这种干扰不会让她立刻输，但会加速消耗她的体力和灵力。等她打到第十个对手时，灵力会只剩不到三成。”
黯握着栏杆的手指微微收紧，关节发白。他低声问能不能打断，惜若淡淡摇头，但目光已经冷了三分：“不急。清澜还没出全力，她还没拔剑。”
打到第十个对手时，清澜的状态已经明显下滑。第十人是霸王星最强的守擂者，一个沉默寡言的中年战士，用的是霸王星祖传的重剑，重量超过五十斤，但在三倍重力下他单手就能挥动自如。连续硬拼九个回合后，清澜忽然往后跳开，反手拔出了背上那把剑。那是她的第三把剑。第一把是韩昌打的玄铁剑，第二把是黯在知遇星送她的短刀，第三把——是她在忘川接回归尘网碎片后用魅灵的银丝和混沌老祖的真名碎片亲手锻造的剑。剑身极薄，薄到近乎透明，剑刃上有六道极细的银色纹路，每一道纹路都对应归尘网的一根丝。当六道纹路全部亮起时，剑身会发出极轻极细的嗡鸣。
清澜握剑的手势很特别——剑尖朝下，剑柄与地面平行。这个起手式是韩昌在忘川教她的最后一招，也是他唯一没有在她面前使过全力的招式。韩昌说过：这一剑不是用来杀人的，是用来收剑的。当你不需要用剑来解决问题的时候，你才有资格拔出这把剑。
剑身嗡鸣。第十人猛冲上来，重剑带着万钧之力劈下。清澜没有格挡，她的剑轻如无物，沿着重剑的剑脊滑上去，将霸道的力量轻轻拨到身侧三寸之外，然后手腕翻转，剑尖在那人眉心的盔甲扣上轻轻点了一下。不是刺，是点。力道轻得像用毛笔在宣纸上写了一个“收”字。
第十人的动作戛然而止。他的重剑砸进地面半尺深，整个人僵在原地。不是因为被击中了，而是因为刚才那一瞬间，他感受到了某种他从未在战场上感受过的东西——不是杀意，是善意。这个来自紫月星的姑娘不是在征服他，是在告诉他：你的招式我破解了，你可以不用再打了。他沉默了三秒，然后松开重剑，退后一步，向她行了一个霸王星最郑重的军礼。
全场沸腾。清澜收剑入鞘。
这时主持台上传来一阵响亮的掌声。敖征一边鼓掌一边走下来，脸上挂着那个不太对劲的笑，大声宣布紫月联邦的挑战者果然名不虚传，胜者为王试炼的冠军当之无愧，说好要给冠军一份特别的奖励。他右手食指上那枚暗红色的戒指忽然亮了一下，不是之前的幽光，而是刺目的红光。
角斗场的地面猛然震动，石台正中央裂开一道缝隙，一座完全不同的擂台从地底缓缓升起。它比角斗场小得多，通体漆黑，表面光滑如镜，边缘燃烧着幽蓝色的火焰。那些火焰不散发热量，反而在吞噬周围的温度，整个角斗场的空气骤然冷了十几度。
content_en:
Volume Five (Thirty-Seven) Hegemony·World
Overlord is not on the regular route of the Federation Star Territory.
This name is marked as "Hegemon" on the star map, followed by a line of small words: An unregistered independent star field with unknown sovereignty. Enter at your own risk. Jiang Liuyun rummaged through the files of the Federal Intelligence Department and only found three lines - "The gravity is about three times that of the Purple Moon Star. The aborigines are known for their fighting talent. The civilization form is between the tribal alliance and the interstellar city-state. There are two recorded trial sites: the Winner is King Arena and the Inner Demon Dojo. Warning: The rules of the trial site are maintained by the local ancient contract. Once outsiders sign, they must abide by it and cannot go back on it."
He handed the file to Xiruo and asked, "Are you sure you want to take them there?"
Xiruo took the file and glanced at it, raising her sword eyebrows slightly: "Three times the gravity. Just right, Zi Yuexing is too light, these people's bones are almost crispy." She closed the file, with three points of provocation and seven points of determination, "Qinglan was eroded by the Chaos Mirror Spirit in Wangchuan, although the foundation of spiritual power is It’s saved, but some hidden injuries need to be forced out in a high-pressure environment. I’ve heard about the Overlord’s training ground for a long time - the rule of battle there is not who has stronger spiritual power, but who can maintain himself under extreme pressure. This is not a competition for her, but recovery.”
Jiang Liuyun was silent for a while, then nodded: "How do I bring the manpower?"
"Qinglan, An, the five sisters of the Ni family, Shuangshuang and Dongdong will also go - the perception of alien animals is better than that of humans in that kind of place."
Jiang Liuyun looked at Xi Ruo and the two strange beasts without saying anything.
Everyone set out the next day. There is no direct route to Overlord, so they both teleported twice before reaching the periphery. As soon as they passed through the space rift, the gravity alarm on the ship rang. The spiritual power in everyone's body seemed to be filled with lead, and it took three times more effort to move and move than usual. Dongdong shook his head uncomfortably, and Shuangshuang's two heads growled at the same time. Shuangshuang's teleportation ability was at least half suppressed here - the space laws of Overlord are different from elsewhere. The air here smells of rust and old blood, and the ground is dark red hard soil, which makes a fine rustling sound when stepped on. The outline of the mountains in the distance bites the skyline like a row of giant beast's fangs.
The capital of Overlord is a city built with black boulders. There is no city wall because it is not needed - the city itself is a mountain. The entire mountain is hollowed out, and the streets and buildings extend layer by layer along the corridors inside the mountain. At the highest point is a palace, the residence of the Overlord Star Lord.
Star Lord Ao Ba is a strong man nearly two meters tall, with bronze skin, thick beard and hair, and a voice like a bell. He received the Ziyue Federation and his party in the main hall of the palace, with a bold and undisguised arrogance.
However, he does have the capital of arrogance. As the planet with the strongest gravity in the star field, anyone's strength will be greatly suppressed, and his master is still a creation-level figure.
"Purple Moon Federation? I've heard of it. It has become very famous in the star field recently. Even the Deep Space Council asked you to dismantle it." Ao Ba sat on the throne covered with animal skins and looked at Xiruo condescendingly. "But our Overlord Planet does not recognize the Federation or the Parliament. We only recognize fists. If you want to participate in the winner-takes-all trial, you can. Follow the rules - sign the contract, fight in the ring, the winner will get the reward, and the loser will accept his fate. Is that okay?"
Standing next to him was a young man who was as tall and handsome as his father, but there was always a smile that was not right at the corner of his mouth. Ao Ba pointed at him: "This is the dog Ao Zheng, and he will preside over this trial. There should be more exchanges between young people, and I will not get involved."
Ao Zheng cupped his fists and saluted. The gesture was very standard, but when his eyes glanced at Qinglan and the five sisters of the Ni family, he paused for an extra moment, which made people very uncomfortable. It's not a frivolous lust, it's a hunter assessing the value of his prey. Qinglan looked back at him expressionlesslyAt a glance, his hand was pressed on the handle of the short knife at his waist - not a threat, but a habit.
The winner-takes-all arena is located in the arena in the center of the city. A huge circular stone platform, the ground is paved with unknown black stone, and it is covered with dents and cracks of varying depths. Each dent is a mark left by a battle. There is no guardrail on the edge of the stone platform, if you fall you lose. The auditorium stretched upward along the mountain, and it was packed at the moment - the Overlord people's passion for battle had seeped into their blood, and a challenge from an outsider was enough to make the whole city empty out.
The competition format is simple and crude: wheel battle. The challenger fights against ten defenders in a row. If they defeat them all, they will be crowned the champions. The Guardians are composed of the strongest warriors on Overlord, and each has a different fighting style. No rest, no replenishment of spiritual energy, and no change of equipment are allowed in wheel battles. Ao Zheng stood on the hosting platform at the top of the auditorium. His voice was amplified by spiritual power so that it could be heard throughout the arena: "Challenger of the Purple Moon Federation—Yang Qinglan. The first round begins!"
The first defender is a strong man like an iron tower. Even under triple gravity, he still moves as fast as a cheetah. His fists are covered with spiritual armor full of spikes, and each punch comes down with the force of a thousand pounds. Qinglan did not draw the sword. The first principle Han Chang taught her: when facing a powerful opponent, don't just take the first move, look at his habit of exerting force first. She dodged for seven consecutive rounds on the edge of the ring, her steps still as light as a swallow under triple gravity, until she saw clearly that there was an extremely short gap in the left ribs after the strong man swung his right fist. In the eighth round, she cut sideways into the gap, and the back of the short knife struck the nerve plexus under his arm accurately. The strong man's entire right arm was instantly paralyzed, and his iron tower-like body fell to the ground, shaking the stone platform.
The audience was silent for a moment, then erupted into deafening cheers. Overlord people appreciate strong people, regardless of their origins.
Second place is the Serpentine Assassin. The third place is the double swordsman. The fourth place is the long-range psychic archer. Qinglan entered the ring one by one. She first observed each opponent, then dodged, and finally defeated the enemy with a single blow with the least amount of strength. The essence of Han Chang's swordsmanship is not to be fast or ruthless, but to be "accurate". It is to use every ounce of strength on the blade without wasting any of it.
When he reached the seventh time, sweat finally appeared on Qinglan's forehead, and his breathing became slightly quickened. In the audience, Nibo suddenly whispered: "Someone is interfering with the operation of her spiritual power. It's not the opponent in the ring, but someone coming down from above." She pointed her finger in the direction of the host table in a very subtle way. Ni Lian looked in the direction she pointed. Ao Zheng was standing on the stage with his hands behind his back. He looked normal, but a dark red ring on his right index finger was emitting a very faint light. Niying closed her eyes for a moment, and when she opened her eyes again, her voice was as cold as ice: "The ring is releasing an extremely low-frequency spiritual interference wave. It does not affect the defenders on the ring, but only targets Qinglan. The interference frequency is exactly half a beat different from the rhythm of the spiritual energy in her body. This interference will not make her lose immediately, but it will accelerate the consumption of her physical and spiritual energy. By the time she hits the tenth opponent, less than 30% of her spiritual energy will be left."
An's fingers holding the railing tightened slightly, and the joints turned white. He asked in a low voice if he could interrupt. Xiruo shook her head lightly, but her eyes had turned cold: "There's no rush. Qinglan hasn't used her full strength yet, and she hasn't drawn her sword yet."
By the time she hit her tenth opponent, Qinglan's condition had declined significantly. The tenth person is Overlord's strongest defender, a taciturn middle-aged warrior who uses Overlord's ancestral heavy sword. It weighs more than fifty kilograms, but he can swing it freely with one hand under triple gravity. After nine consecutive rounds of hard fights, Qinglan suddenly jumped back and pulled out the sword on her back. That's her third sword. The first one is the black iron sword made by Han Chang, the second one is the short sword given to her by Anzai Zhiyuxing, and the third one is the one she picked up in Wangchuan and returned to the dust net.A sword forged by the fragments using the silver thread of the enchantment and the fragments of the Chaos Ancestor's true name. The sword body is extremely thin, so thin that it is almost transparent. There are six extremely fine silver lines on the blade, and each line corresponds to a thread of the Guichen Net. When all six lines light up, the sword body will emit a very light and fine hum.
Qinglan's gesture of holding the sword is very special - the tip of the sword is facing down, and the hilt is parallel to the ground. This starting move was the last move that Han Chang taught her in Wangchuan, and it was also the only move that he never used his full strength in front of her. Han Chang said: This sword is not used to kill people, it is used to sheath the sword. Only when you don't need to use the sword to solve problems can you be qualified to draw the sword.
The sword buzzed. The tenth man rushed forward and struck down the heavy sword with great force. Qinglan did not block, her sword was as light as nothing, sliding up the sword's spine, gently pushing the domineering power three inches away from her side, then flipping her wrist, the tip of the sword lightly tapped on the armor buckle between the man's eyebrows. Not thorns, just dots. The force is as light as writing the word "collect" on rice paper with a brush.
The movement of the tenth person came to an abrupt halt. His heavy sword hit the ground half a foot deep, and his whole body froze on the spot. Not because he was hit, but because at that moment, he felt something that he had never felt on the battlefield - not murderous intent, but kindness. This girl from Purple Moon Star is not conquering him, she is telling him: I have cracked your moves, you don’t need to fight anymore. He was silent for three seconds, then let go of the heavy sword, took a step back, and gave her the most solemn military salute of Overlord.
The whole place was boiling. Qinglan sheathed her sword.
At this time, there was a burst of loud applause from the host stage. Ao Zheng walked down while applauding, with that awkward smile on his face, and loudly announced that the challenger of the Purple Moon Federation was indeed worthy of his reputation, and that the winner of the winner-takes-all trial was well-deserved, and he agreed to give the champion a special reward. The dark red ring on the index finger of his right hand suddenly lit up, not the faint light before, but a dazzling red light.
The ground of the arena shook suddenly, a gap opened in the center of the stone platform, and a completely different arena slowly rose from the ground. It was much smaller than the arena, completely dark, with a surface as smooth as a mirror, and blue flames burning at the edges. Those flames did not dissipate heat, but instead devoured the surrounding temperature. The air in the entire arena suddenly became colder by more than ten degrees.
